blocks.zh: 本章建立了微生物處置的三個層次框架，由淺至深依序為：
blocks.en: This chapter establishes a three-tier framework for handling microorganisms, from the simplest to the most detailed:

blocks.zh: 特性描述（Characterization）：菌落形態、細胞形態、革蘭氏染色、關鍵生化反應——適用於大多數非無菌製造的風險評估
blocks.en: Characterization: colony morphology, cell morphology, Gram stain and key biochemical reactions; sufficient for risk assessment in most non-sterile manufacturing

blocks.zh: 鑑定（Identification）：到屬或種的水準——無菌製程、無菌試驗陽性、媒介充填失敗時必做
blocks.en: Identification: to genus or species level; mandatory for sterile processes, positive sterility tests and media fill failures

blocks.zh: 菌株分型（Strain Typing）：最精細層次——用於確認污染源頭、流行病學調查
blocks.en: Strain Typing: the finest level; used to confirm the source of contamination and for epidemiological investigations

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把微生物鑑定想像成辨認一個人：特性描述相當於描述外貌（高矮、膚色、髮型）；鑑定相當於知道姓名與國籍（屬與種）；菌株分型則是DNA比對確認是否為同一個人（菌株來源）。製藥的日常巡邏用外貌描述就夠，但出了事故就要驗DNA。
blocks.en: Think of microbial identification as recognizing a person: characterization is like describing appearance (height, skin tone, hairstyle); identification is like knowing the name and nationality (genus and species); strain typing is the DNA match that confirms whether it is the same individual (strain origin). Routine patrols in a pharmaceutical facility can rely on a description of appearance, but once an incident occurs you need the DNA test.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 監管連結：本章明確與三個USP章節掛鉤：
blocks.en: Regulatory links: this chapter is explicitly tied to three USP chapters:

blocks.zh: <62>：非無菌微生物檢查——需要對特定培養基上生長菌落進行確認性鑑定
blocks.en: <62>: Microbiological Examination of Non-sterile Products; colonies growing on specific media require confirmatory identification

blocks.zh: <71>：無菌試驗——鑑定結果可支持試驗作廢（invalidation）的判斷
blocks.en: <71>: Sterility Tests; identification results can support the decision to invalidate a test

blocks.en: <1116>: Microbiological Control and Monitoring of Aseptic Processing Environments; environmental isolates should be identified at an adequate frequency

blocks.zh: Isolation of Pure Cultures 純培養物的分離
blocks.en: Isolation of Pure Cultures

blocks.zh: 表現型特徵 vs. 基因型特徵的根本差異：
blocks.en: Fundamental differences between phenotypic and genotypic characteristics:

blocks.zh: 表現型（Phenotypic）：受培養基、溫度、傳代次數影響，可能漂移——例如在富營養培養基多次傳代後，某些菌落可能喪失部分表現型特徵
blocks.en: Phenotypic: affected by culture medium, temperature and number of passages, and can drift; for example, after repeated subculturing on nutrient-rich medium, some colonies may lose part of their phenotypic characteristics

blocks.zh: 基因型（Genotypic）：DNA/RNA序列高度保守，不受培養條件影響——更可靠，但成本更高、技術更複雜
blocks.en: Genotypic: DNA/RNA sequences are highly conserved and unaffected by culture conditions; more reliable, but more costly and technically complex

blocks.zh: 這是選擇鑑定方法時的核心考量：常規監控用表現型，關鍵調查用基因型。
blocks.en: This is the core consideration in choosing an identification method: use phenotypic methods for routine monitoring and genotypic methods for critical investigations.

blocks.zh: 表現型就像一個人的外貌——可能因環境（曬太陽變黑、節食變瘦）而改變；基因型就像基因組——無論環境如何，序列不變。要確認兩個嫌疑人是否是同一人，外貌對比不夠，DNA才算數。16S rRNA就是微生物界的「DNA指紋」。
blocks.en: Phenotype is like a person's appearance, which can change with the environment (tanning darkens the skin, dieting makes one thinner); genotype is like the genome, whose sequence stays the same whatever the environment. To confirm whether two suspects are the same person, comparing appearance is not enough; DNA is what counts. 16S rRNA is the "DNA fingerprint" of the microbial world.

blocks.zh: 關鍵技術門檻：
blocks.en: Key technical thresholds:

blocks.zh: DNA-DNA雜交 >70%同源性 → 同種（species level）
blocks.en: DNA-DNA hybridization >70% homology: same species (species level)

blocks.zh: 16S rRNA序列同源性：>99%認為同種；>97%認為同屬（有許多例外）
blocks.en: 16S rRNA sequence homology: >99% is considered the same species; >97% the same genus (with many exceptions)

blocks.zh: 公開資料庫（如NCBI GenBank）未必經過驗證——[Caution] 規定明確要求使用已驗證資料庫
blocks.en: Public databases (such as NCBI GenBank) are not necessarily validated; [Caution] the text explicitly requires the use of validated databases

blocks.zh: MALDI-TOF是目前業界廣泛採用的快速全細胞組成分析工具
blocks.en: MALDI-TOF is currently a widely adopted industry tool for rapid whole-cell composition analysis

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在藥廠EM程序設計中，傳統生化鑑定系統（如API條）正逐步被MALDI-TOF取代。MALDI-TOF具有快速（分鐘級）、高通量、成本低的優點，屬於表現型方法（全細胞蛋白質組成），但資料庫覆蓋率至關重要。若遇到罕見環境菌或新型真菌，仍需結合16S/ITS序列分析。
blocks.en: In pharmaceutical EM program design, traditional biochemical identification systems (such as API strips) are gradually being replaced by MALDI-TOF. MALDI-TOF offers speed (minutes), high throughput and low cost; it is a phenotypic method (whole-cell protein composition), but database coverage is critical. For rare environmental bacteria or novel fungi, 16S/ITS sequence analysis is still needed.

blocks.zh: Primary Screening and Characterization 初步篩查與特性描述
blocks.en: Primary Screening and Characterization

blocks.zh: 初步篩查的邏輯樹（Decision Tree）：
blocks.en: Decision tree for primary screening:

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏陽性球菌 + 過氧化氫酶陽性 → Staphylococcus 屬可能
blocks.en: Gram-positive cocci + catalase positive → probable Staphylococcus genus

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏陽性球菌 + 過氧化氫酶陰性 → Streptococcus 屬可能
blocks.en: Gram-positive cocci + catalase negative → probable Streptococcus genus

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏陰性桿菌 + 氧化酶陽性 → 非發酵菌（如 Pseudomonas）
blocks.en: Gram-negative rods + oxidase positive → non-fermenters (such as Pseudomonas)

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏陰性桿菌 + 氧化酶陰性 → 腸桿菌科（Enterobacteriaceae）
blocks.en: Gram-negative rods + oxidase negative → Enterobacteriaceae

blocks.zh: 初步篩查分流錯誤 → 使用錯誤的鑑定試劑盒 → 錯誤結論 → 不適當的糾偏措施。
blocks.en: Incorrect primary screening → wrong identification kit used → wrong conclusion → inappropriate corrective action.

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏染色是微生物鑑定的「第一個分叉路口」：就像在機場安檢時先確認是否持有有效護照，這個基礎分流決定了後續走哪條通道。走錯通道，後續所有努力都是浪費。
blocks.en: The Gram stain is the "first fork in the road" of microbial identification: like confirming at airport security that you hold a valid passport, this basic triage determines which lane you take next. Take the wrong lane and all later effort is wasted.

blocks.zh: 革蘭氏染色常見陷阱 Gram Stain Pitfalls
blocks.en: Gram Stain Pitfalls

blocks.zh: 熱固定過度：革蘭氏陽性誤染為陰性
blocks.en: Excessive heat fixation: Gram-positive organisms mis-stained as negative

blocks.zh: 菌齡過老：出現革蘭氏可變（Gram-variable）反應
blocks.en: Culture too old: Gram-variable reactions appear

blocks.zh: 脫色劑過多：假陰性
blocks.en: Too much decolorizer: false negatives

blocks.zh: 脫色劑不足：假陽性
blocks.en: Too little decolorizer: false positives

blocks.zh: 解決方案：每次必須納入已知革蘭氏陽性和陰性對照菌株，如 S. aureus（陽性）和 E. coli（陰性）
blocks.en: Solution: always include known Gram-positive and Gram-negative control strains, such as S. aureus (positive) and E. coli (negative)

blocks.zh: 關鍵生化篩選試驗 Key Biochemical Tests
blocks.en: Key Biochemical Tests

blocks.zh:
氧化酶試驗（Oxidase Test）：
  陽性（紫色）→ 非發酵菌（Pseudomonas, Burkholderia等）
  陰性（無色）→ 腸桿菌科

過氧化氫酶試驗（Catalase Test）：
  陽性（冒泡）→ Staphylococcus
  陰性（不冒泡）→ Streptococcus

凝固酶試驗（Coagulase Test）：
  陽性 → S. aureus（可能致病）
  陰性 → CoNS（推定無致病性）
blocks.en:
Oxidase Test:
  Positive (purple) → non-fermenters (Pseudomonas, Burkholderia, etc.)
  Negative (colorless) → Enterobacteriaceae

Catalase Test:
  Positive (bubbling) → Staphylococcus
  Negative (no bubbling) → Streptococcus

Coagulase Test:
  Positive → S. aureus (potentially pathogenic)
  Negative → CoNS (presumed non-pathogenic)

blocks.zh: 若革蘭氏染色因操作失誤將革蘭氏陽性菌誤判為陰性，後續鑑定至種的層次會有什麼後果？對EM調查報告有何影響？
blocks.en: If an operator error in Gram staining causes a Gram-positive organism to be misread as Gram-negative, what are the consequences for subsequent identification to species level? What is the impact on the EM investigation report?

blocks.zh: 在IPA消毒劑效力評估中，如果從清潔室表面分離到一株過氧化氫酶陽性、凝固酶陽性的球菌，應如何升級處理？
blocks.en: In a disinfectant efficacy evaluation with IPA, if a catalase-positive, coagulase-positive coccus is isolated from a cleanroom surface, how should it be escalated?

blocks.zh: Microbial Identification by Phenotypic Methods 表現型鑑定方法
blocks.en: Microbial Identification by Phenotypic Methods

blocks.zh: 主要表現型鑑定技術比較：
blocks.en: Comparison of the main phenotypic identification techniques:

blocks.zh: 生化反應試劑盒（API/Vitek）：碳源利用模式，需要特定培養基與接種濃度，結果為概率分數
blocks.en: Biochemical reaction kits (API/Vitek): carbon source utilization patterns; require specific media and inoculum density; results are probability scores

blocks.zh: 脂肪酸分析（FAME/GLC）：全細胞脂肪酸組成，需標準化培養條件，資料庫依賴性高
blocks.en: Fatty acid analysis (FAME/GLC): whole-cell fatty acid composition; requires standardized culture conditions; highly database-dependent

blocks.zh: MALDI-TOF MS：全細胞蛋白質指紋，快速（<10分鐘/株），現代EM的主流工具
blocks.en: MALDI-TOF MS: whole-cell protein fingerprint; rapid (<10 minutes per strain); the mainstream tool in modern EM

blocks.zh: 表現型鑑定就像用一個人的指紋比對資料庫：MALDI-TOF是「現代指紋掃描儀」——快速、準確，但前提是資料庫裡有這個人的紀錄。傳統API試劑盒就像老式的「比對表」——可靠但耗時，需要菌落在特定條件下充分表現。
blocks.en: Phenotypic identification is like matching a person's fingerprint against a database: MALDI-TOF is the "modern fingerprint scanner", fast and accurate, but only if the database holds a record of that person. Traditional API kits are like an old-fashioned "lookup table": reliable but time-consuming, and the colonies must express their traits fully under specific conditions.

blocks.zh: 表現型鑑定的局限性（對監管審查的影響）：
blocks.en: Limitations of phenotypic identification (implications for regulatory review):

blocks.zh: 受培養條件影響，同一株菌可能給出不同結果
blocks.en: Affected by culture conditions; the same strain may give different results

blocks.zh: 資料庫未收錄的菌株 → 無法鑑定，非鑑定失敗
blocks.en: Strains not covered by the database cannot be identified; this is not an identification failure

blocks.zh: 親緣關係近的菌種（如CoNS各種）可能難以區分
blocks.en: Closely related species (such as the various CoNS) may be difficult to distinguish

blocks.zh: 對FDA審查而言，方法選擇必須與鑑定目的（特性描述、鑑定、分型）匹配
blocks.en: For FDA review, the method chosen must match the purpose of identification (characterization, identification, typing)

blocks.zh: 在CDMO無菌充填廠的EM計畫中，建議的鑑定策略：日常監控用MALDI-TOF（快速、高通量）；超限事件或調查中分離株需要種的確認時，用生化試劑盒或16S序列分析補充；媒介充填陽性時，直接升級到基因型方法。
blocks.en: Suggested identification strategy for the EM program of a CDMO aseptic filling facility: use MALDI-TOF for routine monitoring (fast, high throughput); for excursions or investigations where an isolate needs species-level confirmation, supplement with biochemical kits or 16S sequence analysis; when a media fill is positive, escalate directly to genotypic methods.

blocks.zh: Microbial Identification by Genotypic Methods 基因型鑑定方法
blocks.en: Microbial Identification by Genotypic Methods

blocks.zh: 基因型鑑定的適用層次：
blocks.en: Applicable tiers of genotypic identification:

blocks.zh: 種水準鑑定：16S rRNA前500 bp測序（細菌）/ ITS序列（真菌）
blocks.en: Species-level identification: sequencing of the first 500 bp of 16S rRNA (bacteria) / ITS sequence (fungi)

blocks.zh: 菌株分型：PFGE（脈衝場電泳）、MLST（多位點序列分型）、全基因組測序（WGS）
blocks.en: Strain typing: PFGE (pulsed-field gel electrophoresis), MLST (multilocus sequence typing), whole genome sequencing (WGS)

blocks.zh: 篩查特定菌：核酸擴增（PCR）——用於快速篩查，不等同於完整鑑定
blocks.en: Screening for specific organisms: nucleic acid amplification (PCR); used for rapid screening and not equivalent to full identification

blocks.zh: 16S rRNA序列就像微生物的「身份證號碼」——相同物種的號碼高度相似，但同一種的不同菌株號碼可能一樣（16S無法分型）。要區分同種不同菌株（如追查無菌充填污染源），必須用PFGE或WGS——相當於比對指紋中的細節花紋，而不只是看主要弧線。
blocks.en: The 16S rRNA sequence is like a microorganism's "ID number": organisms of the same species have highly similar numbers, but different strains of one species may have identical numbers (16S cannot type strains). To distinguish different strains of the same species (such as when tracing the source of aseptic filling contamination), PFGE or WGS must be used; this is like comparing the fine ridge patterns within a fingerprint rather than only looking at the main arcs.

blocks.zh: 南方雜交（Southern Hybridization）的使用要求：
blocks.en: Requirements for the use of Southern hybridization:

blocks.zh: 必須使用兩種以上不同限制性內切酶
blocks.en: Two or more different restriction endonucleases must be used

blocks.zh: 兩菌株的所有條帶必須完全一致才能認定為同一菌株
blocks.en: All bands of the two strains must be completely identical for them to be considered the same strain

blocks.zh: 這是「有罪推定的反面」——條帶相同不能確定是同一株，條帶不同則確定不是同一株
blocks.en: This is the flip side of "presumption of guilt": identical bands cannot confirm that the strains are the same, but different bands definitely confirm that they are not

blocks.zh: 使用16S rRNA序列鑑定，若分離株與資料庫最高比對結果為99.2%，是否可以確認到種的水準？USP文中的閾值是多少？
blocks.en: When using 16S rRNA sequence identification, if the best database match for an isolate is 99.2%, can it be confirmed to species level? What is the threshold stated in the USP text?

blocks.zh: 核酸擴增法（PCR）應用於微生物篩查時，可能面臨哪些USP明確列出的挑戰？
blocks.en: When nucleic acid amplification (PCR) is applied to microbial screening, what challenges explicitly listed by USP may be encountered?

blocks.zh: Verification of Microbial Identification Methods 鑑定方法的驗證
blocks.en: Verification of Microbial Identification Methods

blocks.zh: 三種驗證路徑及其適用情境：
blocks.en: Three verification pathways and their applicable situations:

blocks.zh: 路徑一（平行測試）：最接近實際使用場景，適用於新系統取代舊系統時，用EM計畫中的實際分離株比對
blocks.en: Pathway 1 (parallel testing): closest to actual use; suitable when a new system replaces an old one, comparing actual isolates from the EM program

blocks.zh: 路徑二（已知菌株測試）：快速，適用於初始驗證，選用12-15種代表性菌株，共50次測試
blocks.en: Pathway 2 (testing of known strains): fast; suitable for initial verification; select 12-15 representative strains, for a total of 50 tests

blocks.zh: 路徑三（第三方比對）：最具客觀性，適用於高風險方法，20-50株，含15-20不同種
blocks.en: Pathway 3 (third-party comparison): most objective; suitable for high-risk methods; 20-50 strains, including 15-20 different species

blocks.zh: 統計指標速查 Statistical Metrics Quick Reference
blocks.en: Statistical Metrics Quick Reference

blocks.zh:
2×2混淆矩陣：
              參考法陽性  參考法陰性
新法陽性  a(TP)       c(FP)
新法陰性  b(FN)       d(TN)

敏感性（Sensitivity）= a/(a+b) × 100
特異性（Specificity） = d/(c+d) × 100
陽性預測值（PPV）    = a/(a+c) × 100
陰性預測值（NPV）    = d/(b+d) × 100
分析準確性           = (a+d)/(a+b+c+d) × 100
Kappa指數            = 2(ad-bc)/[(a+c)(c+d)+(a+b)(b+d)]

注意：PPV 受流行率影響，非方法固有特性！
blocks.en:
2×2 confusion matrix:
              Reference method positive  Reference method negative
New method positive  a(TP)       c(FP)
New method negative  b(FN)       d(TN)

Sensitivity = a/(a+b) × 100
Specificity = d/(c+d) × 100
Positive predictive value (PPV) = a/(a+c) × 100
Negative predictive value (NPV) = d/(b+d) × 100
Analytical accuracy = (a+d)/(a+b+c+d) × 100
Kappa index = 2(ad-bc)/[(a+c)(c+d)+(a+b)(b+d)]

Note: PPV is affected by prevalence and is not an inherent property of the method!

blocks.zh: 鑑定錯誤層次及影響 Error Hierarchy
blocks.en: Error Hierarchy

blocks.zh: 最嚴重：屬水準誤鑑 → 可能導致完全錯誤的CAPA方向（如把 Pseudomonas 誤鑑為 Bacillus，消毒方案完全不同）
blocks.en: Most serious: genus-level misidentification → may lead to a completely wrong CAPA direction (for example, misidentifying Pseudomonas as Bacillus, which calls for entirely different disinfection programs)

blocks.zh: 中等：種水準誤鑑 → 可能影響風險評級（如CoNS中，某些種具有更強耐藥性）
blocks.en: Moderate: species-level misidentification → may affect risk ranking (for example, among CoNS, some species have stronger antibiotic resistance)

blocks.zh: 最輕：無法鑑定 → 知道不知道，可以採取替代措施
blocks.en: Least serious: no identification → you know what you do not know and can take alternative measures

blocks.zh: PPV受流行率影響的比喻 Analogy for PPV
blocks.en: Analogy for PPV

blocks.zh: 想像你用同一個火災警報器測試：在日常辦公室（火災罕見），每次警報大多是誤報（PPV低）；在煉油廠（火災風險高），同樣的警報系統PPV就高得多。方法的固有能力（敏感性、特異性）不變，但在不同環境中的預測價值不同。這對製藥EM重要：稀有致病菌在生產環境的流行率極低，即使測試陽性，也需要高度懷疑假陽性。
blocks.en: Imagine testing with the same fire alarm: in an ordinary office (fires are rare), most alarms are false alarms (low PPV); in an oil refinery (high fire risk), the same alarm system has a much higher PPV. The inherent capability of the method (sensitivity, specificity) does not change, but its predictive value differs between environments. This matters for pharmaceutical EM: the prevalence of rare pathogens in the production environment is extremely low, so even when a test is positive, a false positive must be strongly suspected.

blocks.zh: 驗證一套新的MALDI-TOF鑑定系統，計畫選擇路徑二（已知菌株），請列出應納入的菌株類別（以清潔室常見菌為例）？
blocks.en: You are validating a new MALDI-TOF identification system and plan to choose Pathway 2 (known strains). List the categories of strains that should be included (using common cleanroom organisms as examples).

blocks.zh: 若鑑定系統對CoNS的準確率只有82%，能否接受？依據USP的標準，應如何評估？
blocks.en: If an identification system has an accuracy of only 82% for CoNS, is that acceptable? How should it be evaluated according to the USP criteria?

blocks.zh: Kappa指數的意義是什麼？Kappa = 0.7代表什麼程度的一致性？
blocks.en: What does the Kappa index signify? What level of agreement does Kappa = 0.7 represent?

blocks.zh: Phylogenetic Considerations & Glossary 系統發育考量與術語表
blocks.en: Phylogenetic Considerations & Glossary

blocks.zh: 分類學革命對製藥業的影響：
blocks.en: Impact of the taxonomic revolution on the pharmaceutical industry:

blocks.zh: 基於16S rRNA的系統發育分析導致許多熟悉菌種改名，例如：Aspergillus niger ATCC 16404 改名為 A. brasiliensis——這直接影響到USP藥典的微生物對照品名稱。製藥公司的EM資料庫和SOPs都可能需要相應更新，若使用舊名稱可能在監管審查中引發問題。
blocks.en: Phylogenetic analysis based on 16S rRNA has led to the renaming of many familiar species, for example Aspergillus niger ATCC 16404 was renamed A. brasiliensis; this directly affects the names of microbial reference materials in the USP compendium. Pharmaceutical companies' EM databases and SOPs may need corresponding updates, and using old names may raise issues in regulatory review.

blocks.zh: 多相分類學的比喻 Polyphasic Taxonomy Analogy
blocks.en: Polyphasic Taxonomy Analogy

blocks.zh: 多相分類學就像法庭的「多方面定罪標準」：不能只憑一個DNA序列就下結論，必須同時考慮外貌（表現型）、行為模式（生理特性）、來源地（分離地點）、歷史記錄（測試歷史）。單憑基因型資料做出的鑑定結論，如果與其他特徵完全矛盾，就應當懷疑是錯誤結果。
blocks.en: Polyphasic taxonomy is like the "multifaceted standard of proof" in a court: you cannot reach a conclusion from a single DNA sequence alone, but must consider appearance (phenotype), behavior patterns (physiological properties), place of origin (isolation site) and historical records (testing history) together. If an identification based on genotypic data alone completely contradicts the other characteristics, it should be suspected of being wrong.

blocks.zh: 重要術語精要 Key Terms Summary
blocks.en: Key Terms Summary

blocks.zh: 分類（Classification）：排列進分類系統——最廣泛的框架
blocks.en: Classification: arranging into a classification system; the broadest framework

blocks.zh: 特性描述（Characterization）：描述特性以供趨勢分析——不需要完整鑑定
blocks.en: Characterization: describing properties for trend analysis; does not require full identification

blocks.zh: 鑑定（Identification）：確定屬或種——需要與參考菌株比對
blocks.en: Identification: determining genus or species; requires comparison with reference strains

blocks.zh: 分型（Typing）：確定菌株——最精細、最費工的層次
blocks.en: Typing: determining the strain; the finest and most labor-intensive level

blocks.zh: 模式菌株（Type Strain）：作為物種定義參考的標準菌株，通常儲存於ATCC/DSMZ等公認菌株庫
blocks.en: Type Strain: the standard strain that serves as the reference for defining a species, usually deposited in recognized culture collections such as ATCC/DSMZ

blocks.zh: 當 Aspergillus niger 改名為 A. brasiliensis 時，USP對照品的標籤和相關SOP需要更新。如果公司的EM系統仍記錄為舊名，在藥典比對時會出現名稱不符。建議做法：在EM資料庫中同時維護當前接受名稱和歷史名稱（synonym）欄位，並在分析報告中標注分類學更新資訊，以確保監管文件的一致性。
blocks.en: When Aspergillus niger was renamed A. brasiliensis, USP reference material labels and related SOPs needed updating. If the company's EM system still records the old name, a name mismatch will appear when compared with the compendium. Recommended practice: maintain both the currently accepted name and the historical name (synonym) fields in the EM database, and note the taxonomic update in analytical reports, to ensure consistency of regulatory documents.

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Chapter Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: 三層次框架：特性描述（日常EM）→ 鑑定到屬/種（超限、無菌試驗陽性）→ 菌株分型（污染源調查）
blocks.en: Three-tier framework: characterization (routine EM) → identification to genus/species (excursions, positive sterility tests) → strain typing (contamination source investigation)

blocks.zh: 表現型方法：快速、經濟，但受培養條件影響；MALDI-TOF是現代主流；資料庫覆蓋是關鍵瓶頸
blocks.en: Phenotypic methods: fast and economical, but affected by culture conditions; MALDI-TOF is the modern mainstream; database coverage is the key bottleneck

blocks.zh: 基因型方法：更可靠、不受培養條件影響；16S rRNA用於種鑑定；PFGE/WGS用於菌株分型；通常委外進行
blocks.en: Genotypic methods: more reliable and unaffected by culture conditions; 16S rRNA for species identification; PFGE/WGS for strain typing; usually outsourced

blocks.zh: Gram染色：鑑定第一關；每次必須包含陽/陰性對照；避免過多/過少脫色劑的假結果
blocks.en: Gram stain: the first gate of identification; always include positive/negative controls; avoid false results from too much or too little decolorizer

blocks.zh: 驗證指標：準確性和再現性是最重要的；目標一致率 >90%；錯誤層次：屬誤鑑 > 種誤鑑 > 無鑑定
blocks.en: Validation metrics: accuracy and reproducibility are the most important; target agreement rate >90%; error hierarchy: genus misidentification > species misidentification > no identification

blocks.zh: PPV依賴流行率：在製藥環境中，致病菌流行率低，PPV不高，需謹慎解讀陽性結果
blocks.en: PPV depends on prevalence: in pharmaceutical environments, pathogen prevalence is low and PPV is not high, so positive results must be interpreted with caution

blocks.zh: 多相分類學：不能單憑基因型資料下結論；需結合表現型、來源和歷史紀錄
blocks.en: Polyphasic taxonomy: do not conclude from genotypic data alone; combine phenotype, source and historical records

blocks.zh: 監管連結：與<62>、<71>、<1116>密切相關；分類學名稱更新（如A. brasiliensis）需及時更新SOP
blocks.en: Regulatory links: closely related to <62>, <71> and <1116>; taxonomic name updates (such as A. brasiliensis) require timely SOP updates
